text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Applying the most appropriate training 
load , and managing her emotionally by 
chatting during breaks…

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Splendid… Absolutely splendid! You must be 
the most extraordinary trainer in history! 
I'm so glad to be a reporter of this era…!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, I can't stay like this. I have to go 
back to the office and write an article as 
soon as possible…!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
"An outstanding trainer who loves Uma 
Musume and is determined to devote their 
life to them is at Tracen Academy." …!
